summary: This is a Docker Compose configuration that builds and runs a PHP application container. It sets up user IDs for the container to match the host system, mounts the local project directory into the container, and configures the working directory where commands will run.

explanations.1: This disables spell-checking for this YAML file, useful since it contains variable placeholders and technical terms.
explanations.8: DOCKER_UID=1000 sets the numeric user ID inside the container; this should match your host machine's UID (found by running 'id -u') to avoid file permission issues.
explanations.9: DOCKER_GID=1000 sets the group ID inside the container; like UID, this should match your host's GID (found by running 'id -g') so container processes have the right permissions.
explanations.12: The %%name=php-app%% is a placeholder that Docker Compose will replace with an actual container name when you run it.
explanations.16: This mounts your local project folder (the dot means current directory) into the container at /opt/behat, so changes you make locally instantly appear in the container.
